data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'kaiaphas', meaning 'to be enthroned' or 'to take the seat of a judge'. In the New Testament, Caiaphas is the name of the high priest who oversaw the trial of Jesus of Nazareth. The name Caiaphas carries the meaning “High Priest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Caiaphas usually hope their child will grow to embody high priest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caiaphas total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קאייפא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאייפא הוא השם העברי של הכהן הגדול ששימש בתקופת ישוע המשיח, והוא מוזכר בברית החדשה. מקור השם הוא כנראה מהמילה העברית 'קוף', שמשמעותה 'דיכוי' או 'שקט'. השם קאייפא היה שם נפוץ בקרב היהודים בתקופת בית שני, והוא מוזכר בספרים של יוסף בן מתתיהו ובתלמוד. הכהן הגדול קאייפא היה אחראי על הדיון במשפטו של ישוע המשיח ועל גזר הדין נגדו.

in_greek.name: Καϊάφας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καϊάφας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος קאייפא, που σημαίνει 'καταπιεστής' ή 'σιωπηλός'. Ο Καϊάφας ήταν ο αρχιερέας που υπηρέτησε κατά την περίοδο του Ιησού Χριστού και αναφέρεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη. Το όνομα Καϊάφας ήταν κοινό μεταξύ των Ιουδαίων κατά την περίοδο του Β' Ναού, και αναφέρεται στα έργα του Ιωσήπου και στο Ταλμούδ. Ο αρχιερέας Καϊάφας ήταν υπεύθυνος για την 심판을 του Ιησού Χριστού και την καταδίκη του.

in_latin.name: Caiaphas
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Caiaphas is derived from the Hebrew name קאייפא, which signifies 'repression' or 'silence'. Caiaphas was the High Priest who served during the time of Jesus Christ and is mentioned in the New Testament. The name Caiaphas was common among Jews during the Second Temple period and is referenced in the works of Josephus and the Talmud. The High Priest Caiaphas was responsible for the trial of Jesus Christ and his condemnation.

in_english.name: Caiaphas
in_english.long_meaning: The name Caiaphas originates from the Hebrew name קאייפא, meaning 'repressor' or 'silencer'. Caiaphas was the High Priest during Jesus Christ's time, mentioned in the New Testament. The name was common among Jews during the Second Temple period. Caiaphas played a significant role in Jesus' trial and condemnation. The name Caiaphas symbolizes spiritual oppression and silence.

data.cultural_impact: Caiaphas is a name deeply rooted in biblical history. His name has been passed down through centuries, leaving a profound impact on the Judeo-Christian tradition and the history of Western civilization. He is best known for his role in the events leading to the crucifixion of Jesus Christ. Caiaphas was the high priest of the Second Temple in Jerusalem at the time of Jesus' trial, a position of great religious and political power. His questionable involvement in Jesus' trial has been the subject of much debate and interpretation in art, literature, and scholarship for centuries.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Caiaphas holds tremendous spiritual significance not only for Christians but for all peoples of the Abrahamic faiths. As the high priest of the Jewish temple during Jesus' time, Caiaphas was tasked with upholding the Mosaic law and maintaining the religious and moral purity of the Jewish people. However, in his willingness to conform to the demands of the Roman authorities by sanctioning Jesus' trial and eventual execution, Caiaphas demonstrated a failure of moral leadership and a disregard for the sanctity of life. For many Christians, this tragic episode serves as a reminder of the importance of moral integrity, justice, and the dignity of human life, even during times of political and religious strife. Ultimately, the story of Caiaphas highlights the question of how one can preserve one's spiritual ideals while navigating the complex challenges of the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Caiaphas was the high priest during Jesus' trial before the Sanhedrin. His name signifies 'god has been merciful', yet ironically, he presided over the trial that led to Jesus' crucifixion, embodying the complexities of human nature.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Caiaphas was the high priest of the Jewish Temple in Jerusalem during the time of Jesus. The name Caiaphas carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
